name: _reopen.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  space-playground/_reopen.scss — the floating Experience-Settings reopen button shown after the panel is dismissed.
//  Imported by space-playground.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Floating reopen button (Experience Settings) ─────────────────────────────
// Styled identically to .expand-modal-open-1 with animated corner borders.

// Reopen-panel button shown when the panel is collapsed.
.#{$_B_SP}-reopen {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  display: none; // managed by JS; shown on desktop when panel is collapsed

  @include layout-1024() {
    position: relative;
    pointer-events: auto;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
    // Floats over the always-dark space scene — fixed light ink, not
    // --text-primary (dark in light mode → invisible on the canvas).
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    background: transparent;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-2xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-2xs));
    transition:
      color 0.2s ease,
      opacity 0.2s ease;

    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-md);
      height: to-rem($space-md);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        height 0.25s ease;
    }

    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      color: var(--color-accent);

      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        border-color: var(--color-accent);
      }
    }
  }
}
